title: Cyclone Akvan could end Hyderabad's cold dry spell by Nov 21

slides.head: Cyclone Akvan could end Hyderabad's cold dry spell by Nov 21
What happened
slides.body: Cyclone Akvan is expected to form over the Bay of Bengal on Nov 16-17 and cross the coast between Chennai and Bapatla, focused on south Andhra Pradesh, around Nov 19.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: After landfall, the system is forecast to push rain across Telangana from Nov 20 to 22.

slides.head: dawn low, Moula Ali & BHEL
slides.body: Before the rain, Moula Ali and BHEL are still dipping to around 14°C at dawn.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: Thunderstorms with lightning are possible in 8 districts including Warangal, Karimnagar and Mancherial.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: IMD updates once the cyclone forms on Nov 16-17; district alerts for Nov 20. Ask: How will rain on Nov 21-22 affect standing crops in drought-hit districts?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

Cyclone Akvan could end Hyderabad's cold dry spell by Nov 21

IMD Hyderabad says Cyclone Akvan may bring rain to Telangana from Nov 20, with Hyderabad likely to see showers on Nov 21-22.

Why it matters: After landfall, the system is forecast to push rain across Telangana from Nov 20 to 22.
